title: Mưa Xanh Từ Giếng Dưới Chân Cành

scenes.narration: Tháng ba nắng gắt, vườn cà phê Tây Nguyên nứt nẻ như da người già chờ đợi.
scenes.narration_en: In scorching March heat, the Central Highlands coffee garden cracked like old skin waiting for rain.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot of a weathered Vietnamese farmer standing amidst parched, cracked red earth and browning coffee bushes in the drylands of Vietnam. Harsh golden sunlight casts deep shadows on his tired face covered in dust. He looks up at a bright blue sky with worry. High contrast, realistic texture.

scenes.narration: Không tiền thuê máy bơm, anh quyết định dùng chiếc cuốc cũ để đào xuống tận gốc rễ.
scenes.narration_en: With no money for pumps, he decided to use his old hoe and dig down deep into the roots himself.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic close-up of a muscular Vietnamese farmer in simple worn clothes sweating profusely while digging hard red soil with an iron-tipped wooden hoe. Dust particles float in shafts of strong sunlight illuminating dirt on his skin and arms. Intense effort, earthy tones.

scenes.narration: Ngày qua ngày, lớp đất xốp dần nhường chỗ cho dòng nước mát từ tầng sâu vọng lên.
scenes.narration_en: Day after day, loose soil gave way to cool water rising from deep underground layers below.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic shot inside a narrow dark dug hole in red earth. A clear stream of sparkling groundwater flows into the basin where the farmer stands waist-deep with his hoe resting against muddy walls. Sunlight filters down beams illuminating floating dust and bubbles.

scenes.narration: Khi nước ngập rìa miệng giếng, anh vội vã tưới từng gốc cây đang héo úa dưới mặt trời.
scenes.narration_en: As water filled the well's rim, he hurriedly irrigated each withered tree under the blazing sun above them all together now.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic wide shot of the farmer carrying a wooden bucket full of clear water running back to save dying coffee plants near where groundwater emerges naturally from ground level into basin area behind him. Steam rises gently around soaking roots transforming dry brown leaves turning green again.

scenes.narration: Mùa cà phê bội thu năm ấy, nhưng anh chỉ cười thầm khi nhìn giọt nước đầu tiên len lỏi.
scenes.narration_en: That year the coffee harvest was abundant, yet he only smiled quietly watching that first droplet seep through soil layers silently into earth below ground level slowly spreading outward everywhere around him peacefully without noise.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic medium shot of the same Vietnamese farmer sitting on a tree stump smiling gently at golden hour light reflecting off fresh green coffee leaves surrounding him. His clothes are still dusty but clean now after rain has fallen overnight washing away all grime from previous days' work leaving behind peace instead of struggle visibly.

scenes.narration: Giếng nước ấy vẫn chảy, tưới mát cả vùng đồi núi, như một lời tri ân từ lòng đất.
scenes.narration_en: That well still flows today watering entire mountainous regions as a silent thank-you gift from the very heart of our planet itself giving life back to those who cared deeply enough for others even when no one else seemed willing help them out at all times every single day without fail ever since then until now forever more.
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical cinematic wide landscape shot showing lush green coffee forests stretching across misty mountains in Central Highlands Vietnam with clear blue sky above. A small wooden well structure stands prominently on hillside surrounded by vibrant vegetation contrasting sharply against earlier barren scenes shown previously establishing emotional arc completed successfully here today finally.
